body.p: The moon came, the moon was enamoured, came to the Mullymoola damsels. They were catching kaioong, were roasting with hot stones piamingBulbous reed that grows in swamps. and kaioongA small kind of fish, so called by the aborigines., at Poolinjerunga, near Kān. They went to Jiudoula. The Southron heard them. Where are they singing about me? I hear them singing about me in the gully; let me have pipe clay to corroboree; sing that song; let me dance. I'll spear you in the eye. They go under the ground - they went up to the sky; the sisters became stone.
